changelog: Library phase: creates the Coming Soon library and one placeholder per movie/season with poster, status, progress and ETA (locked metadata, newest first). Playback of placeholders is refused (PlaybackInfo) with a Stop + message fallback; watch state cleared. Stubs removed when the real item arrives. Restart-safe.
description: Keeps a shared "Coming Soon" library of requested movies and shows that haven't arrived yet, with download progress and ETA in the item overview. Placeholder items are not playable.
name: Coming Soon
overview: Download progress library for Seerr, Sonarr and Radarr
